title.en: A TCP connection: why a client skips bind, and the sender's two windows (Q12, Q11)
title.zh: 一条 TCP 连接：客户端为什么不用 bind，以及发送方的两个窗口（第 12、11 题）

description.en: What the socket primitives do and why only the server needs a known port; what the flow control window and the congestion window each protect, and what breaks if a sender ignores them.
description.zh: 套接字原语各做什么，为什么只有服务器需要一个公开的端口；流量控制窗口和拥塞窗口各保护谁，发送方不守它们会坏在哪里。

name.zh: 套接字编程与 Berkeley 套接字 (socket programming)

name.en: TCP window management and flow control
name.zh: TCP 窗口管理与流量控制 (TCP window management, flow control)
流量控制与拥塞控制的区别 (flow control vs congestion control)

name.en: TCP's sending rate: the flow control window and the congestion window
name.zh: TCP 发送速率：流量控制窗口与拥塞窗口 (flow control window and congestion window)
网络拥塞与有效吞吐量 (network congestion and goodput)

description.en: Thinking a client must bind a fixed port so that replies can find it
description.zh: 以为客户端必须绑定一个固定端口，回复才找得到它

description.en: Thinking the flow control window and the congestion window protect the same thing
description.zh: 以为流量控制窗口和拥塞窗口保护的是同一个对象

title.zh: 模拟卷 · 第 12 题（2 分）

paras.en: Explain why a TCP client would not typically invoke the bind primitive.
paras.zh: 解释为什么 TCP 客户端通常不调用 bind 原语。

items.en: **A TCP client** is the side that starts a connection: a browser, a mail program. The **server** waits for clients to connect.
items.zh: **TCP 客户端**是发起连接的一方：浏览器、邮件程序。**服务器**等着客户端来连。

items.en: **The bind primitive**: one of the Berkeley socket primitives, the calls a program makes to use TCP. BIND attaches a local address, an IP address and a port, to a socket.
items.zh: **bind 原语**：伯克利套接字的原语之一，也就是程序使用 TCP 时调用的那些操作。BIND 把一个本地地址（IP 地址加端口）绑定到套接字上。

items.en: **Would not typically**: usually it does not, though it may. The answer must say why it can do without, and who does the job instead.
items.zh: **通常不**：一般不调用，但也可以调用。答案要说清它为什么可以不调用，以及这件事由谁代劳。

chapter.zh: 第 12 题：不用 bind 的客户端

text.en: A **socket** is a transport endpoint that a program creates and the operating system manages. The course's Berkeley socket primitives:
text.zh: **套接字**（socket）是一个传输端点，由程序创建、由操作系统管理。课上讲的伯克利套接字原语：

rows.en: Associate a local address (IP address and port) with a socket
rows.zh: 把一个本地地址（IP 地址和端口）关联到套接字上

rows.en: Announce willingness to accept connections; give the queue size
rows.zh: 表示愿意接受连接；给出等待队列的长度

rows.en: Wait for and accept an incoming connection
rows.zh: 等待并接受一个到来的连接

rows.en: Actively attempt to establish a connection
Send some data over the connection
Receive some data from the connection

blocks.code:
SERVER                         CLIENT
socket()                       socket()
bind(port 80)
listen()
accept()   <-- connection -->  connect(128.250.1.7, 80)
receive() / send()             send() / receive()
close()                        close()

text.en: The two columns are not symmetric: the server calls **bind** (and listen and accept), the client goes straight from socket to **connect**.
text.zh: 两列并不对称：服务器调用 **bind**（还有 listen 和 accept），客户端从 socket 直接就到了 **connect**。

title.zh: 谁需要一个公开的地址

text.en: A server binds because clients must be able to find it. It attaches its socket to a **well-known port** (80 for the web, 25 for mail), and every client that wants the service connects to that IP address and port.
text.zh: 服务器要 bind，是因为客户端得找得到它。它把套接字绑定到一个**知名端口**（网页 80，邮件 25），想要这项服务的客户端都连这个 IP 地址和端口。

text.en: Nobody connects to a client: the client is the one who calls. So its address need not be known in advance, and the operating system can choose it. When the client calls **connect**, the operating system binds the socket for it: the local IP address of the interface the connection leaves by, and a free **dynamic** (ephemeral) port. The connection request carries that address and port as its source, so the server learns them when the request arrives and sends its replies there.
text.zh: 没有人会去连客户端：打电话的是客户端自己。所以它的地址不必事先公开，可以交给操作系统来选。客户端调用 **connect** 时，操作系统替它完成绑定：本地 IP 地址取连接出去的那个网络接口的地址，端口取一个空闲的**动态端口**（临时端口）。连接请求把这个地址和端口作为源地址带过去，服务器收到请求时就知道了，回复也就发回那里。

text.en: A fixed port would even get in the way: two copies of the same client on one machine would both want it. A client binds by hand only when it must send from a particular address or port, for example on a host with several network interfaces.
text.zh: 固定端口反而碍事：同一台机器上开两个同样的客户端，会抢同一个端口。只有必须从某个特定地址或端口发出时，客户端才自己 bind，比如一台有好几个网络接口的主机。

prompt.en: A browser opens two tabs on the same web server. How do the server's replies reach the right tab?
prompt.zh: 浏览器在同一个网站上开了两个标签页。服务器的回复怎样到达正确的标签页？

label.en: The browser bound each tab to a fixed port of its own
label.zh: 浏览器给每个标签页绑定了自己的固定端口

feedback.en: No bind is needed: the operating system picks a free port at connect.
feedback.zh: 不需要 bind：connect 时操作系统会挑一个空闲端口。

label.en: Each tab's connection was given its own dynamic port, so the two connections differ in the client's port
label.zh: 每个标签页的连接都分到了自己的动态端口，两条连接的客户端端口不同
靠客户端的 IP 地址

feedback.en: Both tabs share the laptop's IP address; only the port tells them apart.
feedback.zh: 两个标签页共用笔记本的 IP 地址；只有端口能把它们分开。

explain.en: A TCP connection is identified by four numbers: the client's IP and port, the server's IP and port. The two tabs differ in the client's port, which the operating system chose.
explain.zh: 一条 TCP 连接由四个数标识：客户端的 IP 和端口、服务器的 IP 和端口。两个标签页的客户端端口不同，而这个端口是操作系统挑的。

text.en: Two marks, two links: who binds the client's socket instead (the operating system, at connect), and why the client's port need not be known (the server learns it from the request). A line on why the server *must* bind makes the contrast clear.
text.zh: 2 分，两环：客户端的套接字由谁来绑定（操作系统，在 connect 时），以及为什么客户端的端口不必事先知道（服务器从请求里得知）。再加一句服务器为什么*必须* bind，对比就清楚了。

title.en: Practice exam, Q12 · a full-mark answer
title.zh: 模拟卷第 12 题 · 满分答案

paras.en: A TCP client does not need a fixed, known port, because no one connects to it: it initiates the connection. When it calls connect, the operating system automatically binds the socket to a local IP address and a free dynamic port. The server does not need to know the client's port in advance; it learns the client's address and port from the incoming connection request and replies to them. (A server, by contrast, must bind to a well-known port so that clients can find it.)
paras.zh: TCP 客户端不需要固定的、公开的端口，因为没有人去连接它：是它发起连接。它调用 connect 时，操作系统自动把套接字绑定到一个本地 IP 地址和一个空闲的动态端口。服务器不需要事先知道客户端的端口；它从到来的连接请求中得知客户端的地址和端口，并向它们回复。（相反，服务器必须绑定一个知名端口，客户端才能找到它。）

title.zh: 模拟卷 · 第 11 题（4 分）

paras.en: Explain the role of each of the following windows, and describe the potential failures that might occur if a host transmitting data ignored them.
paras.zh: 说明下面每个窗口的作用，并描述发送数据的主机若无视它们可能出现的故障。

items.en: **A window** is how much data the sender may have sent but not yet had acknowledged. A TCP sender keeps two of them.
items.zh: **窗口**是发送方可以发出、但还没得到确认的数据量。TCP 发送方同时守着两个窗口。

items.en: **The role** of each: what it protects, and who sets it.
items.zh: 每个窗口的**作用**：它保护谁，由谁来定。

items.en: **Potential failures if ignored**: what goes wrong, and where it goes wrong. 4 marks: a role and a failure for each window.
items.zh: **无视它们可能出现的故障**：会出什么错，错在哪里。4 分：每个窗口一个作用、一个故障。

title.en: Two things a sender can overrun
title.zh: 发送方可能压垮的两样东西

text.en: A TCP sender may have at most one window of unacknowledged data in flight, so it sends about one window per round trip: its rate is roughly the window divided by the RTT. Two different things can be overrun by a sender that sends too fast, and each has its own window.
text.zh: TCP 发送方在路上的未确认数据最多只能有一窗，所以每个往返大约发一窗：速率约等于窗口除以 RTT。发得太快，会压垮两样不同的东西，各由一个窗口来管。

alt.en: A sender, three routers with queues, and a receiver with a partly full buffer. Over the routers: the congestion window, what the network can take. Over the receiver: the flow control window, the free buffer space. The sender sends min(cwnd, rwnd) per RTT.
alt.zh: 一个发送方、三台带队列的路由器、一个缓冲区半满的接收方。路由器上方：拥塞窗口，网络承受得了多少。接收方上方：流量控制窗口，缓冲区剩余空间。发送方每个 RTT 发 min(cwnd, rwnd)。

caption.en: Two limits on one sender: the receiver's free buffer, and the network's queues. It obeys the smaller.
caption.zh: 一个发送方，两道限制：接收方缓冲区的剩余空间，以及网络里的队列。它听小的那个。

items.en: **The flow control window** protects the **receiver**. In every segment it sends back, the receiver advertises how much free space is left in its buffer, and the sender must not have more unacknowledged data than that. It matters when a fast sender meets a slow receiver, or an application that is slow to read. At a window of 0 the sender stops (and now and then sends a tiny probe, in case the window update was lost).
items.zh: **流量控制窗口**保护的是**接收方**。接收方在发回的每个报文段里通告自己缓冲区还剩多少空间，发送方在路上的未确认数据不能超过这个量。快的发送方碰上慢的接收方、或者读数据很慢的应用时，它就起作用了。窗口为 0 时发送方停下（隔一阵发一个很小的探测报文，以防窗口更新丢了）。

items.en: **The congestion window** protects the **network**: the routers' queues along the path. Nobody advertises it; the sender estimates it itself, raising it while all goes well and cutting it when a segment is lost (slow start and additive increase, as in the congestion-control lesson).
items.zh: **拥塞窗口**保护的是**网络**：路径上各路由器的队列。没有谁会通告它；发送方自己估计，一切顺利就调大，丢了报文段就调小（慢启动和加法增大，拥塞控制那一课讲过）。

text.en: The sender obeys both: at most $\min(\text{cwnd}, \text{rwnd})$ unacknowledged data in flight.
text.zh: 发送方两个都要守：路上的未确认数据最多 $\min(\text{cwnd}, \text{rwnd})$。

title.en: What breaks when a window is ignored

text.en: **Ignore the flow control window**, and data arrives faster than the receiving application takes it. The buffer fills and overflows, and the receiver has to **drop** arriving segments. The sender times out and sends them again, so the bandwidth spent on them was wasted, and the transfer is slower, not faster.
text.zh: **无视流量控制窗口**，数据来得比接收方应用取走得快。缓冲区装满、溢出，接收方只好**丢弃**新到的报文段。发送方超时后重发，花在它们身上的带宽白费了，传输反而更慢。

text.en: **Ignore the congestion window**, and the queues at the busiest router on the path fill up. Delay grows, then the router drops packets, many of them, from every connection that crosses it. Senders time out and retransmit, adding still more traffic, until the network carries mostly copies and little useful data, the **goodput**, gets through: congestion collapse. A sender that ignores its congestion window also takes an unfair share from the connections that respect theirs.
text.zh: **无视拥塞窗口**，路径上最忙的那台路由器的队列就会塞满。延迟越来越大，接着路由器开始丢包，丢得很多，所有经过它的连接都受影响。发送方超时重传，又加了更多流量，最后网络运的大多是副本，真正有用的数据（**有效吞吐量** goodput）没多少能通过：拥塞崩溃。无视拥塞窗口的发送方，还会从守规矩的连接那里抢走不公平的份额。

prompt.en: A receiver's buffer is full, and it advertises a window of 0. Which failure is the sender being asked to avoid?
prompt.zh: 接收方的缓冲区满了，它通告的窗口是 0。这是在请发送方避免哪种故障？

label.en: Segments dropped at the receiver because there is no room for them
label.zh: 报文段因为没地方放，在接收方被丢掉

label.en: Packets dropped in routers' queues along the path
label.zh: 分组在路径上的路由器队列里被丢掉

feedback.en: That is what the congestion window prevents. The window the receiver advertises is about its own buffer.
feedback.zh: 那是拥塞窗口要避免的。接收方通告的窗口只关乎它自己的缓冲区。

explain.en: The advertised window is the receiver's free buffer space: flow control. The network's queues are the congestion window's business.
explain.zh: 通告的窗口是接收方缓冲区的剩余空间：流量控制。网络里的队列归拥塞窗口管。

say.en: The sender may have at most the smaller window in flight: $W_c$ is the congestion window, $W_r$ the window the receiver advertises. Take $W_c = 12$ KB, $W_r = 8$ KB and an RTT of 10 ms.
say.zh: 发送方在路上的数据最多是两个窗口中较小的那个：$W_c$ 是拥塞窗口，$W_r$ 是接收方通告的窗口。设 $W_c = 12$ KB，$W_r = 8$ KB，RTT 为 10 ms。

say.en: Here the receiver's buffer is the limit.
say.zh: 这里限制来自接收方的缓冲区。

say.en: The rate $R$: about one window per round trip.
say.zh: 速率 $R$：每个往返大约一窗。

say.en: 8 KB is 65 536 bits, sent every 10 ms: about 6.6 Mbps.
say.zh: 8 KB 是 65 536 位，每 10 ms 发一次：约 6.6 Mbps。

outro.en: If the receiver frees its buffer and advertises 64 KB, the congestion window becomes the limit: 12 KB every 10 ms, about 9.8 Mbps. Whichever is smaller decides.
outro.zh: 如果接收方腾出缓冲区、通告 64 KB，限制就换成了拥塞窗口：每 10 ms 12 KB，约 9.8 Mbps。哪个小，哪个说了算。

prompt.en: The congestion window is 12 KB and the advertised window 8 KB. How many KB may be in flight?
prompt.zh: 拥塞窗口 12 KB，通告窗口 8 KB。路上最多能有多少 KB？

text.en: For each window: what it is, whom it protects, and the failure, with where the packets are lost (at the receiver, or in the network).
text.zh: 每个窗口写三样：它是什么、保护谁、出什么故障，并说明包丢在哪里（在接收方，还是在网络里）。

title.en: Practice exam, Q11 · a full-mark answer
title.zh: 模拟卷第 11 题 · 满分答案

paras.en: (1) The flow control window is the free buffer space advertised by the receiver; its role is to prevent the sender from sending more data than the receiving host can store in its buffer. If the sender ignored it, the receiver's buffer would overflow and the receiver would drop the arriving segments, which must then be retransmitted, wasting bandwidth.
paras.zh: (1) 流量控制窗口是接收方通告的缓冲区剩余空间；作用是防止发送方发出超过接收主机缓冲区所能存放的数据。发送方若无视它，接收方缓冲区会溢出，接收方会丢弃到达的报文段，这些报文段必须重传，浪费带宽。

paras.en: (2) The congestion window is the sender's estimate of how much data the network can carry; its role is to prevent the sender from overloading the network, i.e. the routers' queues along the path. If the sender ignored it, router queues would overflow, so the network would add delay and drop many packets; the resulting retransmissions add more load, and the useful throughput (goodput) of every connection sharing the path can collapse.
paras.zh: (2) 拥塞窗口是发送方对网络能承载多少数据的估计；作用是防止发送方让网络（即路径上各路由器的队列）过载。发送方若无视它，路由器队列会溢出，网络会增加延迟并丢弃大量分组；由此产生的重传进一步加重负载，共用这条路径的所有连接的有效吞吐量可能崩溃。

paras.en: The sender may have at most min(flow control window, congestion window) of unacknowledged data in flight.
paras.zh: 发送方在途的未确认数据最多为 min(流量控制窗口, 拥塞窗口)。

title.en: Flow control and congestion control, side by side
title.zh: 流量控制和拥塞控制，并排看

rows.en: the receiver, advertised in every segment's window field
rows.zh: 接收方，写在每个报文段的窗口字段里

rows.en: a fast sender overruns a slow receiver
rows.zh: 快的发送方压垮慢的接收方

rows.en: too much traffic for the routers in the middle
rows.zh: 流量多得中间的路由器扛不住

text.en: A test for which one a situation is about: who is too slow? If it is the receiving host, flow control; if it is something in between, congestion control. A fast receiver on a slow, crowded path needs congestion control and no flow control at all.
text.zh: 判断一个情形归哪个管，就问：谁太慢了？是接收主机，就是流量控制；是中间的某处，就是拥塞控制。快的接收方隔着一条又慢又挤的路径，需要的就只有拥塞控制，完全用不上流量控制。

prompt.en: A gigabit server sends a large file to a fast laptop over a path whose slowest link is a busy 10 Mbps line. Which window will mostly limit the sender?
prompt.zh: 一台千兆服务器给一台很快的笔记本发大文件，路径上最慢的一段是一条繁忙的 10 Mbps 线路。主要是哪个窗口在限制发送方？

feedback.en: The laptop is fast and keeps its buffer empty; the bottleneck is in the middle of the network.
feedback.zh: 笔记本很快，缓冲区总是空的；瓶颈在网络中间。

explain.en: The slow, busy link is in the network, so losses there keep the congestion window small; the laptop's advertised window stays large.
explain.zh: 又慢又忙的那段链路在网络里，那里的丢包让拥塞窗口一直偏小；笔记本通告的窗口一直很大。

title.en: Your turn: why the server binds
title.zh: 你来：服务器为什么要 bind

prompt.en: Why must a TCP server call bind, while a client usually need not?
prompt.zh: 为什么 TCP 服务器必须调用 bind，而客户端通常不用？

key_points.en: Clients must know the server's address and port in advance: the server binds to a well-known port
key_points.zh: 客户端必须事先知道服务器的地址和端口：服务器绑定知名端口

key_points.en: Nobody connects to the client; the operating system binds it to a dynamic port at connect
key_points.zh: 没人去连客户端；connect 时操作系统给它绑定一个动态端口

key_points.en: The server learns the client's port from the connection request
key_points.zh: 服务器从连接请求里得知客户端的端口

model_answer.en: Clients must be able to find the server, so it binds its socket to a well-known port that clients connect to. Nobody connects to a client, so the operating system binds the client's socket to a free dynamic port when it calls connect, and the server learns that port from the incoming request.
model_answer.zh: 客户端得找得到服务器，所以服务器把套接字绑定到客户端会去连的知名端口。没人去连客户端，所以客户端调用 connect 时，操作系统把它的套接字绑定到一个空闲的动态端口，服务器再从到来的请求里得知这个端口。

explain.en: The asymmetry comes from who calls whom: the side that waits must be findable.
explain.zh: 不对称来自谁打给谁：等着被找的一方，必须找得到。

title.en: Your turn: where the loss happens

prompt.en: Many senders ignore their congestion windows and share one router. What happens?
prompt.zh: 很多发送方都无视拥塞窗口，共用一台路由器。会怎样？

label.en: Its queue overflows, packets are dropped, retransmissions add load, and goodput falls for everyone
label.zh: 它的队列溢出、丢包，重传加重负载，所有人的有效吞吐量都下降

feedback.en: The receivers may be idle; the overload is in the router they all share.
feedback.zh: 接收方可能闲着；过载发生在大家共用的那台路由器上。

label.en: Nothing, as long as every receiver advertises a large window
label.zh: 没事，只要每个接收方都通告一个大窗口

feedback.en: A large advertised window says the receivers have room; it says nothing about the network.
feedback.zh: 通告的窗口大，只说明接收方有地方放；对网络什么都没说。

explain.en: Congestion is a property of the shared path: only the congestion window, which every sender must respect, keeps it in check.
explain.zh: 拥塞是共享路径的事：只有每个发送方都守的拥塞窗口才能管住它。
